description: Opt-in automerge for non-breaking minor, patch, pin, and lock file updates. Also merges prek patches, and 0.x pre-commit hook and GitHub Action updates.

packageRules.description: A breaking change, such as a semver 0.x minor, can pass every check and still break behaviour no test covers
Consumers that pin prek run it in a required check, so a broken 0.x patch fails before merge. Renovate updates every prek pin in one PR, so that check tests all of them

A 0.x hook or action only changes CI, and the PR's own checks run it. uses-with is excluded because it covers tools such as prek, whose minors wait for review. Majors belong to automerge-workflow-majors
Repeats default.json's release-job hold, which the rules above override because they apply later
